title: Octopus reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='44' cy='39.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 48 Q50 52 55 48' stroke='#b03060' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M30 50 Q20 58 14 70 Q12 76 16 74 Q22 70 26 62' stroke='#e05a8a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M66 55 Q72 66 76 76 Q78 82 72 78 Q66 70 64 60' stroke='#e05a8a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 50 Q80 58 86 70 Q88 76 84 74 Q78 70 74 62' stroke='#d04a7a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Book - left page -->
  <path d='M30 62 L50 58 L50 78 L30 82 Z' fill='#f5f0d0'/>
  <!-- Book - right page -->
  <path d='M50 58 L70 62 L70 82 L50 78 Z' fill='#e8e0b8'/>

  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#c8b878' stroke-width='2'/>

  <path d='M30 82 L50 78 L70 82' stroke='#c07030' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='34' y1='66' x2='47' y2='64' stroke='#a09060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='70' x2='47' y2='68' stroke='#a09060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='74' x2='47' y2='72' stroke='#a09060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Text lines on right page -->
  <line x1='53' y1='64' x2='66' y2='66' stroke='#a09060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='68' x2='66' y2='70' stroke='#a09060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='72' x2='66' y2='74' stroke='#a09060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tentacles holding book -->
  <path d='M42 56 Q38 60 34 64' stroke='#e05a8a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 56 Q62 60 66 64' stroke='#e05a8a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
